$comment: Type-checking config for the test tree. src/ keeps the stricter tsconfig.json;
this file only relaxes options whose value is specific to shipped code:
- noUncheckedIndexedAccess: tests index fixtures and arrays whose shape they have
just asserted, so requiring a guard on every index adds noise without catching bugs.
- allowJs/checkJs: tests import plain-JS helpers under scripts/ (not shipped) and
src/viewer/ (shipped as the packaged viewer's browser assets, not compiled by tsc).
- lib adds dom because the viewer tests exercise browser-side viewer code.
- types adds vitest/globals because vitest.config.ts sets globals: true, so some suites
Everything else, including strict and exactOptionalPropertyTypes, stays on.
